label: Fugue in C minor, BWV 582
caution: Read from Tobi's MusicXML file (Tobis Notenarchiv), notes, ties and names as they stand there; the voices were sorted by this program from the file's staves, stems and beams, and have not been proofread note by note. The pedal's line is the bass. The fugue follows the passacaglia without a break: its first note is the middle C of the passacaglia's last chord, and the rest of that chord is left out here.
title: Passacaglia and Fugue in C minor, BWV 582: Fugue
